Trafford Top Gun

Commanding and refined, Top Gun is a bold expression of grounded masculinity and quiet strength. It opens with an earthy intensity that settles into a deeply sophisticated woody core, evoking the confidence of a man who leads without needing to announce it.

As it evolves, rich vetiver and smooth cedar create a structured warmth, while patchouli adds depth and intrigue. A subtle touch of benzoin lingers in the background, leaving behind a soft, resinous trail that feels both powerful and comforting.

Trafford Turbo Sport

Dynamic and invigorating, Turbo Sport captures the raw energy of motion and the calm confidence of the open horizon. It’s a scent that blends freshness with depth — designed for those who thrive on momentum and live life in full drive.

A cool mineral accord brings a crisp, oceanic clarity, while smoky incense adds a layer of mystery and sophistication. As it settles, warm amber emerges, creating a smooth, lasting trail that feels both modern and effortlessly powerful.

Fresh yet intense, this fragrance is built for those who move fast, think sharp, and leave a lasting impression wherever they go.
